subject: economy
title: Five Year Plans of India (1951-2017)
description: All 12 Five Year Plans with focus areas, targets, and achievements

content.overview: India adopted Five Year Plans from 1951 to 2017, inspired by the Soviet model. The NITI Aayog replaced the Planning Commission in 2015.
keyPoints: First Plan (1951-56): Focus on agriculture, irrigation, power. Target growth: 2.1%, Achieved: 3.6%
Second Plan (1956-61): Focus on heavy industries, Mahalanobis model. Target: 4.5%, Achieved: 4.2%
Third Plan (1961-66): Focus on agriculture, self-sufficiency. Target: 5.6%, Achieved: 2.4% (drought, wars)
Plan Holiday (1966-69): Three annual plans due to Indo-Pak war, drought, devaluation
Fourth Plan (1969-74): Growth with stability, Garibi Hatao. Target: 5.7%, Achieved: 3.3%
Fifth Plan (1974-79): Poverty alleviation, self-reliance. Target: 4.4%, Achieved: 4.8%
Rolling Plan (1978-80): Janata Party government, no fixed targets
Sixth Plan (1980-85): Poverty alleviation, employment. Target: 5.2%, Achieved: 5.7%
Seventh Plan (1985-90): Employment generation, productivity. Target: 5.0%, Achieved: 6.0%
Eighth Plan (1992-97): Economic liberalization, human development. Target: 5.6%, Achieved: 6.8%
Ninth Plan (1997-2002): Growth with social justice. Target: 6.5%, Achieved: 5.4%
Tenth Plan (2002-07): Inclusive growth, 8% growth target. Target: 8.0%, Achieved: 7.6%
Eleventh Plan (2007-12): Faster and more inclusive growth. Target: 9.0%, Achieved: 8.0%
Twelfth Plan (2012-17): Faster, sustainable, inclusive growth. Target: 8.0%, Achieved: 7.0%
NITI Aayog (2015): Replaced Planning Commission, cooperative federalism

quiz.question: Which plan focused on heavy industries?
quiz.explanation: Second Plan (1956-61) focused on heavy industries using Mahalanobis model

quiz.question: Planning Commission was replaced by:
quiz.explanation: NITI Aayog replaced Planning Commission in 2015

quiz.question: Which plan had 'Garibi Hatao' as slogan?
quiz.explanation: Fourth Plan (1969-74) had 'Garibi Hatao' as slogan
